title: ICG Rescues Six Fishermen in Adverse Weather Conditions off the Coast of Mangaluru
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Defence

ICG Rescues Six Fishermen in Adverse Weather Conditions off the Coast of Mangaluru

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
30 JUN 2026 2:02PM by PIB Delhi

The Indian Coast Guard successfully rescued six fishermen from the distressed Indian Fishing Boat (IFB) Manju Matha in a challenging Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR) operation off the coast of Mangaluru on June 29, 2026. ICG Ship Sachet intercepted a VHF RT distress call at about 1600 hrs from a fishing boat located about 33 nautical miles off the Suratkal coast, reporting severe flooding and hull damage due to rough sea conditions, placing the lives of all six crew members at imminent risk. Responding without delay, ICG diverted the ship to render assistance, effecting a rendezvous with the distressed.

Despite extreme weather conditions, including rough seas, strong winds, poor visibility, the crew of ICGS Sachet executed the operation with remarkable efficiency. The crew deployed remote-operated lifebuoys specifically designed for use in inclement sea conditions to safely reach and recover the stranded fishermen. By 1800 hrs, all the six members were rescued safely. The ICGS Sachet is currently entering New Mangalore for the safe disembarkation of the rescued crew.

The operation stands as a testament to the Indian Coast Guard’s unwavering commitment to safeguarding life at sea. It highlights the effective integration of modern technology with the courage, training, and professionalism of Coast Guard personnel in overcoming the most demanding maritime emergencies.

***

SR/Kamlesh
